newsitem.title: USA: Geotek meets Q1 user target, sees expansion.
newsitem.headline: Geotek meets Q1 user target, sees expansion.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc said it met its first quarter target of over 2,000 paying subscribers, bringing the total number of users on the network to more than 3,200.
The company said it plans to expand its presence in Florida with the launch of its Tampa network on April 30, 1997.
Tampa will be Geotek's ninth major metropolitan market and its third in Florida.
The company already provides secure wireless voice and packet data services in Miami and Orlando.
